title: POST /api/v1/timer/start (request body)
description: Start a fixed or device-randomized duration. Either duration_ms (fixed) or the min_ms/max_ms pair (random) must be present; sending both is rejected.

duration_ms.description: Fixed duration in ms. Must be 1..24h.

min_ms.description: Random-mode inclusive lower bound. Required with max_ms.

max_ms.description: Random-mode inclusive upper bound. Must be >= min_ms and <= 24h.
